content.json:
# MEI-MCP Audit Dashboard
This dashboard displays metrics, security events, and tool usage generated by the Microsoft Engineering Intelligence MCP server.

content.query:
AppTraces
| where Properties['event'] == 'audit'
| summarize Count=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), tostring(Properties['tool'])
| render timechart
content.title: Tool Executions over Time

content.query:
AppTraces
| where Properties['event'] == 'security'
| project TimeGenerated, SeverityLevel, Message, User=Properties['userId'], Action=Properties['tool']
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Recent Security & Authorization Events
